mapper.select: SELECT ca.id, ca.source_type, ca.advice_name, ca.school_id, ca.user_id, ca.category_id, ca.author, ca.mobile, ca.file_url, ca.status, ca.check_content, ca.create_time, ca.create_user, ca.update_user AS authorUpdate, ca.update_time, ca.audit_remark, sm.school_name AS schoolName, di.type_name AS categoryName, CASE ca.source_type WHEN 1 THEN '教师端' WHEN 2 THEN '家长端' WHEN 3 THEN '班主任' ELSE '未知' END AS sourceTypeDesc, CASE ca.status WHEN 0 THEN '未处理' WHEN 1 THEN '已处理' ELSE '未知' END AS statusDesc FROM t_content_advice ca LEFT JOIN t_school_manage sm ON ca.school_id = sm.id LEFT JOIN t_base_dict_item di ON ca.category_id = di.id AND di.is_valid = 1 WHERE ca.id = #{id} AND ca.is_valid = 1
